# ARKA Constructions — company and website reference

ARKA Constructions is a construction company based in Maraimalai Nagar, Chengalpattu, Tamil Nadu. It serves Chennai and nearby areas across residential, commercial, industrial and civil construction.

## Capabilities

- Civil and RCC works
- Earth and site development
- Flooring works
- Fabrication and structural steel works
- Glazing and aluminium works
- Paver block works
- Painting works
- Plumbing and drainage
- Road and external works
- Waterproofing works
- Demolition works
- Repair and maintenance
- Industrial works

The company is led by Kamarajan Krishnan, proprietor and engineer. Its approach covers understanding requirements, planning scope and cost, building with quality checks, and handing over with one year of maintenance labour support.

## Service areas

Main areas: Chennai and Chengalpattu.
Nearby areas: Maraimalai Nagar, Kanchipuram, Thiruvallur, Thiruvannamalai, Oragadam, Sriperumbudur, Mahindra World City and Singaperumal Koil.

## Home construction packages

- Essential: ₹2,449 per sq ft
- Signature: ₹2,699 per sq ft
- Elite Luxury: ₹3,449 per sq ft

Home projects start from 1,200 sq ft. Final quotations depend on the plot, floors, materials, approvals, site conditions and project scope.
